verdict.rationale: Sprinto has a docs page titled 'Send and Review Security Questionnaires' indicating some questionnaire-handling capability, but there is no evidence of support for specific formats like SIG, CAIQ, portals, or spreadsheets, nor of import/export in the customer's original format. missing for 10: format-specific import/export details (SIG, CAIQ, portal, spreadsheet), evidence of round-tripping questionnaires in original format, any independent/hands-on confirmation.
